evals.prompt: Run inference on a folder of images with my trained getitune checkpoint and produce a checkable output. I have not provided the checkpoint, model recipe, image folder, or any paths; no task assets are available in this environment.
evals.expected_output: The agent asks for the checkpoint, matching model or recipe, and input images before execution. It may explain the workflow, but does not invent paths, predictions, or a successful run.
assertions: Requests the checkpoint, matching model or recipe, and input image location.
Does not claim to have run inference or produced predictions.

evals.prompt: Compare inference from my exported OpenVINO model with my trained checkpoint. This is a new session with no previous results. I have not provided the XML/BIN files, checkpoint, matching model recipe, or evaluation data; no task assets are available in this environment.
evals.expected_output: The agent requests the XML/BIN pair, checkpoint and matching model or recipe, and common evaluation inputs. It explains that both models must be evaluated on the same data and does not fabricate a comparison.
assertions: Requests the XML/BIN pair, checkpoint and model or recipe, and common evaluation data.
Explains that comparison requires running both models on the same inputs.
Does not assume earlier results or claim measured parity.

evals.prompt: Write Python code only; do not execute it. With getitune 0.4.0, compare my efficientnet_b0 checkpoint ./weights/classifier.ckpt and its already-quantized OpenVINO model ./int8/model.xml (BIN alongside it) using ./dataset, which has a test subset. Obtain metrics and predictions from both. Do not train, export, or quantize again.
evals.expected_output: Creates a checkpoint-backed engine and a separate XML-backed engine with the same dataset, tests and predicts with both, and stays in inference rather than optimizing an already-quantized model.
assertions: Loads efficientnet_b0 with checkpoint=./weights/classifier.ckpt and task=MULTI_CLASS_CLS (or its unambiguous recipe), rather than just the model name.
Creates a separate engine with model=./int8/model.xml and the same ./dataset.
Calls test() and predict() for both engines.
Does not call train(), export() or optimize(), and does not claim measured results.
